note: Small RV park at the end of Windermere Dr in a quiet Fayetteville neighbourhood, off I-95. Directory listings (not the operator) describe about 14 sites with 30/50-amp, mostly full hookups, a dump station and Wi-Fi, for short and long stays. No website of its own; phone from its Google listing. --Claude
summary: No operator website or booking engine: the website field is an unclaimed RoverPass listing ('Claim my Campground', 'Last Updated: 11/15/2024'). No 2024+ operator rate (Campendium's last reported rate is $40, December 2023); price only the RV Life $ tier. No gateway within 40 km; family has not stayed here.
